label: H.R. 5458
title: CCAMPIS Reauthorization Act

items.item: Child Care Access Means Parents in School Program
items.snippet: This bill reauthorizes through FY2031 and revises the Child Care Access Means Parents in School Program.
The program awards grants to support the participation of eligible low-income parents in postsecondary education through the provision of campus-based child care services.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

C001101.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
C001101.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
C001101.note: None of this member's itemized donors work in the industries of this bill's lobbying clients.
